UNBLOCKED. This bead was parked at 17:0xZ when I ruled that d_ent must not land, and the blocker
was bd-01M177SHFXZKMR8K39BPC9K6FF -- the cost blend having no support carrier. THAT LANDED at
545b65b and was repaired at 4bd02b0. The reason for the park is gone.

WHY IT WAS PARKED, so the thread is intact: admitting Entity to MayBeMissing removed its imputed
0.5 at weight 0.4, and because the blend was a BARE SUM OVER PRESENT TERMS, removing a term
removed its penalty. Every participant-less unit became 0.2 cheaper to anchor EVERYWHERE. We would
have converted "we could not measure entity agreement" into "this unit matches better", which is
worse than the imputation it replaced. m1 implemented it, saw four failures, identified two as
behavioural rather than pinned, and STOPPED before touching expectations.

WHAT CHANGED: the blend now scales the present-term sum UP TO ELIGIBLE SUPPORT per cell and
records supportWeight. So a term that is ELIGIBLE but UNMEASURED no longer silently discounts the
cell -- the remaining terms scale up to compensate, and the receipt says how much was imputed.
That is precisely the mechanism whose absence made d_ent dangerous.

THE QUESTION THIS NOW TURNS ON, and it is m1's to answer rather than mine to assume: WHEN A UNIT
HAS NO SPECIFIED PARTICIPANTS, IS Entity ELIGIBLE-BUT-UNMEASURED, OR INELIGIBLE?

  If ELIGIBLE: W_present shrinks while W_eligible does not, the cost scales up, and the old
  defect is genuinely gone. d_ent lands.

  If INELIGIBLE: it leaves the eligible basis entirely, there is no scaling to compensate, and we
  may be back where we started with a smaller denominator instead of a missing numerator.

That is the same per-cell eligibility question that decided Chart, and the answer is a property of
what "entity agreement" MEANS for a unit that names no entities -- not a property of the
arithmetic. My instinct is INELIGIBLE, because a unit with no participants has no entity agreement
to fail to measure, in the same way a chartless node has no chart distance. But my instincts on
this bead have been overturned twice today by people who went and measured, so treat that as a
hypothesis.

m1 holds this bead. The branch is parked at 8fdb9da on m1/parked-dent with the mechanism, the
measured movements and the four failures in the commit body, so nothing needs reconstructing.

NOT URGENT. The blend and its repair both landed within the hour and re-measuring on a tree that
new should wait until it has settled. But the park reason is discharged and the bead should not
read as blocked when it is not.
